Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 6.1, 7.1-7.2, 7.5; courts C/E/J. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: M1 implementation.
Integration parent: bd-01M16KDH0TM7DF2BC0K08TH0TT; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M34JJ6YR2K714HPAPT8YTES6.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own shared state/actions and narrow AppView/VoyageView injection seams. Qualify Address by source representation or recall inventory/segmentation; keep result identity separate. Retain CommonViewState, NavigationIndex, both zoom axes and LatestIntent protection. Standalone wrappers create a controller.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. One action produces one committed transition; row+candidate correspondence context survives source/matrix navigation without syncing two writable stores.
2. Focus, selection, hover, viewport, independent horizons and playback cursors stay separate; identical local IDs in two artifacts cannot alias.
3. Out-of-order work cannot activate; tighter horizon/capability revocation removes incompatible old content immediately. Cache/decoration shortcuts require full-compilation equivalence.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Retain standalone wrappers and full compilation oracle; disable integrated route rather than synchronizing competing stores.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [M1] Introduce one artifact-qualified workspace controller
